title: China urges 'practical actions' from Dutch government to resolve Nexperia dispute
summary: China urged the Netherlands to take practical steps to resolve the Nexperia dispute and support affected firms. Minister Wang Wentao blamed Dutch intervention and a court ruling removing Nexperia’s CEO for semiconductor supply chain turmoil after the government took control to prevent relocation to China.

title: Delhivery launches all-women distribution centre in Kochi
summary: The Kochi facility features specially designed, women-centric infrastructure with secure rest areas, changing facilities, ergonomically designed workspaces, enhanced safety and security features, and flexible work arrangements to support work-life balance, the company said.

title: COP30: India pitches for expanding joint crediting mechanism for global climate action
summary: India is advocating for the expansion of a bilateral Joint Crediting Mechanism (JCM) as a vital tool for global climate action. Spearheaded by Japan, this model allows countries to jointly develop mitigation projects and transparently allocate emission reduction credits, reinforcing multilateral climate objectives.

title: Russia signals support for India’s air combat needs: Offers Su-57 fighter tech transfer; calls New Delhi’s demands ‘acceptable’
summary: Russia has offered India unrestricted technology transfer for its Su-57 fifth-generation fighter jets, including production and licensing for critical components. This significant defence partnership aims to bolster India's future fighter aircraft needs, ensuring domestic manufacturing capabilities and long-term upgrades, reinforcing over six decades of cooperation ahead of President Putin's visit.

title: Sortera is turning America’s scrap aluminum problem into cash
summary: Sortera has developed an AI-guided system to sort scrap aluminum by specific grades. The startup is building a second sorting facility in Tennessee.

summary: OpenAI is updating ChatGPT Atlas with vertical tabs that make it look a bit like the Arc browser.
